additionalIntentSurfaces.QPP_CHANGE: No live setter in main; initial URL/recent launch only. Add runtime setter without changing UI text.
additionalIntentSurfaces.PROFILE_CHANGE: resize only changes CSS screen scale; page offsetWidth/height remains A4. Keep screen-fit observer; explicit layout profile intent handles layout changes.
additionalIntentSurfaces.FONT_INVALIDATION: No main event entry; add explicit runtime entry and font completion listener after initial font readiness.
additionalIntentSurfaces.ASSET_INVALIDATION: No main event entry; explicit intent accepts asset version.
additionalIntentSurfaces.PAGE_LAYOUT_INVALIDATION: No main event entry; explicit intent accepts page layout version.
additionalIntentSurfaces.ENGINE_INVALIDATION: No main event entry; explicit intent accepts engine version.

inputSchema.sourcePayloadReads: prepareArchiveCanonicalContent reads content/question only. formatQuestionContent accepts q but does not read its fields. Retain an immutable projection of content/question for dual-run; never the raw payload graph.
inputSchema.currentFreeze: print-contract.createCanonicalQuestion freezes outer object and sourceRef; choices is shallow sliced, choice objects and sourcePayload retain mutable references. render-authority freezes outer array only.
inputSchema.strategy: Project actual executor fields without changing alias/whitespace behavior; copy plain arrays/objects recursively and freeze the copy; reject cycles, accessors, functions, symbols, non-finite numbers and non-plain objects. Candidate canonical data includes the immutable executor projection. Do not freeze raw globals.

sessionLifecycle.load: Normalize script path (including same-origin blob), load one script at a time, await metadata; capture and restore questionBank/examTitle/examDisplayTitle globals in finally. Canonicalize immutable source data before build.
sessionLifecycle.failure: Invalid path, load error, canonicalization/schema failure, build failure and stale request abort pending state; preserve old committed source, root, URL, controls and MathJax ownership.
sessionLifecycle.promotion: promotePendingSession materializes a separate complete session in PREPARE; synchronous COMMIT swaps prepared pointer and marks pending PROMOTED; never mutate pending into CURRENT
sessionLifecycle.cleanup: After successful COMMIT only, clear MathJax for retired nodes and remove DOM; cleanup failure stays pending for later serialized retry, without rolling back the new session. No persistent cross-source residency.
